candidate: RC14 plus one WSC-triggered forward correction cue
origin: Our adaptation inspired by WSC; not the official rollback implementation
hypothesis: An occasional correction cue may shorten inaccurate repetitive reasoning without assuming the current answer is correct. It may instead lengthen reasoning or interrupt necessary correction.
evidence: Three of eight exposed long engineering trajectories would trigger and ended with incorrect answers. Triggers include continued attempts to correct; none establishes that stopping is safe. This is not a classifier validation set.
primary_change: One fixed cue after the first eligible detector event. Preserve RC14, context and KV; do not rewind, force think-end, adjust thresholds or use reference answers.
cue_text: Check the reasoning against the original problem. Correct any concrete mistake, then finish the solution without repeating earlier work.
cue_selection: One generic preregistered proposal; no prompt sweep on the eight exposed cases. Token IDs and tokenizer hash must be frozen before active generation.

detector.native_stream: BF16 decoder27 input, corresponding to HF hidden_states[27]; no historical replay

execution_order: Native forward reads current R state, applies ReBalance, exposes boundary hidden state, and computes original raw maximum probability.
Score the processed boundary, update detector state, and decide whether to begin the fixed cue before current sampling. No generated-future token is used.
RC14 applies its unchanged logit penalty. Call the original sampler to preserve its normal invocation and RNG consumption.
If a cue token is pending, replace the selected token inside an instance-scoped wrapper around Adapter.original_sampler, before Adapter.Sampler reads result.sampled_token_ids.
Both RC14 accepted-token bookkeeping and native ReBalance observe_sample must consume the final replacement token. Never overwrite outside these updates.

Keep the native pre-penalty raw maximum probability for R even on forced cue positions; do not set confidence to one. This is an explicit design choice, and forced positions must be marked for interpretation.
Resume ordinary sampling after the cue; never reset R, RC14 opening/thinking state, or KV. Count the cue in the normal generated-token budget.

interfaces.shared_controller_changes: None proposed. Do not duplicate or patch shared vLLM controller.
interfaces.disabled: Install no hook, wrapper, buffer or RNG call. Preserve original RC14 path.
interfaces.reset: Allocate per fresh request ID/slot; reset on admission; export and clear on finish. Reject reused IDs, preemption, speculation, async, prefix reuse or slot aliasing until separately validated.
interfaces.logprobs: Initial engineering requests must have logprobs disabled; original sampled-token logprobs cannot describe forced cue tokens.

budget.insufficient_remaining_budget: Do not begin cue unless all cue tokens fit; log skipped_budget. Do not reserve or refund extra generation.
budget.real_cost: Cue tokens still require decoding forwards. Report total and thought tokens including cue, cue tokens separately, detector runtime, generation and wall time.

gates_before_active_gpu: Pin exact cue token IDs and verify no think-end, EOS, role or chat-control tokens.
CPU tests for score/processed-boundary alignment, streaks, one-shot firing, slot reset, budget, and actual replacement token entering both controllers.
Disabled and shadow modes must preserve accepted tokens and full control history; do not infer equivalence solely from final answers.
Native fused/batched scorer must match saved-boundary CPU scores and trigger positions at fixed tolerances preregistered before running.

Fixed small engineering run first; reuse old long baseline only while pre-intervention token/control identity holds. Any batch-induced divergence before a request's intervention invalidates its causal comparison.
study_limits: No full frozen benchmark is authorized by this spec; no new data split is frozen.
The eight rows remain exposed engineering data. New development and confirmation require normalized-hash reconciliation.
Candidate versus RC14 alone can assess incremental value but cannot establish interaction synergy. Mechanism-only and no-intervention controls are required for that claim.
Accuracy noninferiority target remains minus two percentage points; small samples cannot establish it. Include errors, caps and all failed or partial runs.
If engineering cannot preserve state and prefix identity, stop. If independent confirmation shows no useful token saving at acceptable accuracy, retain RC14 and reject the cue.
